cell.label: Transurethral resection (TUR). One immediate (within 24 hours) intravesical instillation of chemotherapy (mitomycin-C/40 mg).
Assess risk status: low risk (TaG1, T1G1 ≤3 cm single tumor); high risk (T1G2 multiple tumor, TaG3 tumor, T1G3 tumor, CIS); intermediate risk (all other).
No adjuvant therapy. Follow-up with cystoscopy.
Consider re-TUR when TaT1, high grade tumor has been detected at the initial TUR.
Radical cystectomy or bladder-sparing surgery together with neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy and/or radiation therapy.
